description: Defines a lightweight Codable wrapper 'AnyCodable' for handling heterogeneous JSON payloads, allowing round-trip encoding and decoding of various data types including dictionaries and arrays.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A codable, hashable, and sendable wrapper for holding heterogeneous JSON data types, supporting encoding, decoding, equality checks, and hashing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes 'AnyCodable' with a value of any type, normalizing the value for boolean types.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder)
methods.description: Decodes various JSON types into 'AnyCodable', supporting Bool, Int, Double, String, null, dictionaries, and arrays.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder)
methods.description: Encodes the contained value into JSON, supporting multiple data types including dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts NSNumber instances representing boolean values into Swift bools.
Equality operator for comparing two 'AnyCodable' instances based on their underlying values.

methods.name: hash(into: Hasher)
methods.description: Hashes the 'AnyCodable' value for use in hash-based collections.
